claims.text: Epidural corticosteroid injection: serious neurologic events, some fatal, have been reported
claims.quote: Serious neurologic events, some resulting in death, have been reported with epidural injection of corticosteroids
claims.locator: Warnings › Serious Neurologic Adverse Reactions with Epidural Administration

claims.text: (e.g., spinal cord infarction, paraplegia, quadriplegia, cortical blindness, stroke).
claims.quote: Specific events reported include, but are not limited to, spinal cord infarction, paraplegia, quadriplegia, cortical blindness, and stroke.
claims.locator: Warnings › Serious Neurologic Adverse Reactions with Epidural Administration

claims.text: Safety and effectiveness of epidural use have not been established, and corticosteroids are not approved for it.
claims.quote: The safety and effectiveness of epidural administration of corticosteroids have not been established, and corticosteroids are not approved for this use.
claims.locator: Warnings › Serious Neurologic Adverse Reactions with Epidural Administration
